deviations: Path: RA-4 is drawn after RA-5, the path whose held save the row's save.not_saved names (L226-227). No gate and no scrim: on the 403 the gate closes as SCR-006 does (L226; D09:122 'the dialog is already closed', E09-D06 §3), so nothing overlays the page.

The read-only state turns no control T2: the client disables nothing for it (D09:122) until a session field carries it (D09's CG-2; readonly_until is undeclared, CG-3 L797). The T2 controls drawn are SH-4's admin.locked (§4 L184), unchanged; Save stays T1.

Open (spec owner): while read-only, the strip's 'Unlock now' and Save reopen SCR-149, and its step-up answers 403 session_read_only before either factor (Y:14932-14933); no RA row draws that answer.

Open (spec owner): RA-4 (L226) cites banner.read_only.* (D09:268), but §14 L613 adopts only D09:256-262 and :275-279, so the banner's copy sits outside D03's copy deck, as do inflight.read_only (D09:273) and banner.read_only.until (D09:274), named under 'not drawn': L613 to read "D09's keys verbatim (D09:256-279)", or to name banner.read_only.* and inflight.read_only (review r1 item 3; no board change).

frame-1280 shows SCR-122 scrolled to its end: Save opened the gate, so it was in view, and focus returning to it keeps it there; the page is one column at 1280 and the Save bar is not sticky (D1 L114, §8 L361-362), so the band, the rule, the strip and the PageHeader scroll with <main> (§4 L165-171 names no sticky part) and sit above the viewport, as board 15 draws RA-5. The shell-band slot is outside <main>: the banner stays in view. frame-2560 holds the whole page (DJ).

TopBar, NavRail, RightRail and StatusBar content other than the Admin entry, the env badges and the owner's name is drawn as neutral placeholders (E10-D02 owns it; §1 L97 gives only the sizes); the chrome binds color.surface.app with color.border.subtle dividers (no source names a chrome surface).

Buttons, chips, badges, banners, fields, tiles, tables, menus and dialogs are compositions from tokens: admin controls are 32 px (size.control.comfortable, §4 L176) while the library CMP-001 binds size.control.height (24 px in the file's compact density), and cvsheet v1 cannot set an instance's glyph, fill or border.

The three-strike banner is the kit's CMP-028 warning composition: the triangle (registry 'warning', DS-5 pending), the title in type.ui.body-strong over the body in type.ui.body, color.text.primary on color.status.warning.subtle (9.86, triangle 7.56; §15 L636-637), as E09-D09's board 12 draws it; full width in the shell-band slot under the TopBar (§4 L171-173; D09 DS-6), no radius and no close control (not dismissible while the state holds, D09:122). Its '5 minutes' keeps the body's type: a fixed duration in D09's copy, not a count or a clock (D02:120).

The shell-band slot holds the banner alone: D09 DS-6 stacks CMP-074 EnvBanner first, but these boards carry the env as the TopBar's never-hideable badge (E10-D02:61; §4 L164), as boards 01-10 do (DJ).

strip.locked carries no env badge: it names the shell's own state, not a slice (§4 L167-168), as on boards 04 and 15; it is the strip's only item because §1's data raise no other (OV-2, L275); the read-only state adds none (the banner carries it, D09:122).
SCR-122's PageHeader has no primary action: §8 names none (§4's anatomy has the slot); the band's route is 'Users', as §4 L166 draws it, as on boards 01-04.

Page: RA-4 follows RA-5 (§5 L227, board 15), whose gate held SH-4's save over SCR-122 dirty (§4 L184), so the board draws board 04's SCR-122 at SH-4 (UD-3's role change manager → viewer; every other write T2 admin.locked; Save enabled, described admin.locked) with board 04's review r1 fixes (underlined profile links, the audited-read marker's placeholder), the page board 15 puts under the gate (DJ).

Identity is read-only text rows (Username, E-mail, Display name, Last sign-in), as on boards 01, 04 and 15: §8 L405 starts SCR-122's Tab order at Role; the labels are SCR-123's (L415-416) and SCR-121's (L301).

SCR-122 content this state does not need is drawn as neutral placeholders, both values the spec does not give for alex (the e-mail, display name and last sign-in, sub_002's environment, the limit values, the session row's device, IP and times, the three audit rows and the audited-read marker, whose label §14 does not give) and the effective-permission inputs UD-2 (L385) and UD-18 (L401) give: color.surface.hover bars, radius.control (pills radius.badge), as on boards 01, 04 and 15; boards 43 (UD-2), 55, 56, 97 and 100 draw that content. They are not a loading state (UD-1 is board 42). The cap fields inside Limits' placeholder are writes, T2 admin.locked at SH-4 like every other write.
The role select counts as a write (it edits what the PATCH sends, §8 L372, D18), so at SH-4 it is T2 admin.locked with its draft value kept, as on boards 04 and 15 (DJ on L184's 'every other write').

T2 controls take the kit's t2_button() look (D09:49): color.surface.raised with a 1 px color.border.default hairline, the lock glyph and the full label in color.text.tertiary, the reason under the control in type.ui.caption color.text.secondary; the role and level selects and the grant checkboxes take the same look (local t2_select() and t2_box(), as on board 04), a checkbox keeping its check; the lock is CMP-019 Icon lock, decorative=false, accessible name "Not available" (D09:49): a screen reader hears the name, "unavailable" (aria-disabled), then the reason.

Grant rows (CMP-105 composition), as on board 04: the checkbox, the account and its env badge, the level select and the default profile's link (navigation: enabled, §8 L405); the checkbox and the select are T2 admin.locked with their reasons under them. sub_002's environment is not in §1 (L99) or UD-2 (L385): a placeholder pill.

The profile links (CMP-021, two per frame) are underlined, as on boards 01 and 04 after review r1: a drawn 1 px color.text.link rect under the text, as wide as the estimated text (cvsheet v1 texts take no textDecoration, and e42kit's link() draws none). They are the only enabled controls in the locked grant rows, and colour alone would not carry them: color.text.link is 1.18:1 against the tertiary T2 text beside it, 1.32:1 against the secondary reasons and 2.16:1 against primary text (dark), all under 3:1. The strip item, the other CMP-021 link, is a pill marked by its danger fill, its octagon and 'Unlock now', so the kit's 'colour + position only' link line is dropped from these notes.
The Danger zone's buttons follow the Tab order (§8 L405-406; §13 L585): Reset two-factor, Disable, Delete, each T2 admin.locked (enabled, the kit's destructive look, D02:129), as on board 04.

The Save bar is a raised card (radius.card, space.inset.lg) at the page's end, not sticky, as on boards 01, 04 and 15; Save, in its focus ring, carries its description admin.locked under it, both flush with the bar's end; the status lines (NOT_SAVED) sit at its start.

The change summary '1 change pending: role manager → viewer' keeps one type.ui.body text, as on boards 01-04 and 15: its count opens a sentence and the kit gives sentence counts no split (only the strip title's count takes type.num.base here, STRIP_KIT_DEV).

'Not saved.' (save.not_saved, §14 L602) is the Save bar's result line under the change summary, drawn as board 16 draws save.not_saved_locked: a CMP-027 InlineError of severity warning (the triangle, warning.strong 7.56; type.ui.body, text.primary 9.86 on warning.subtle, §15 L636-637), role="status", polite once after the banner's alert (15:291; D02:693 via §1 L94; D06:35's toast; Y:11302-11304; WCAG 4.1.3).

Focus is back on Save, the control that opened the gate: on close focus returns to it (§13 L586; 05:97), drawn with the kit's CMP-039 ring; nothing else moves focus (D09:250), and the banner takes none.

A focus ring is a 2 px color.focus.ring inner stroke on a wrapper with space.inset.xs (4 px) padding, so it sits 2 px off the control (CMP-039) inside the wrapper's bounds; its radius is the next step (radius.card around radius.control); the wrapper adds 4 px on each side to the layout.

Local kit_fixups() (board 04's review r1 findings 10 and 11; e42kit.py unchanged, a no-op once strip() and rightrail() do the same): the strip title's count '(1)' is its own text node in type.num.base (§6 L287; D02:120; Appendix A L865) beside 'Needs your action' in type.ui.label, the row's space.inset.xs gap standing for the word space and its note carrying the full strip.title string; the strip item is named 'item-01 · CMP-021 Link (composition)' and the rail 'CMP-209 RightRail (composition)' (15:2416).
